item.description:

Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS Central Pacific Hurricane Center Honolulu HI
Issued by NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
200 PM HST Mon Oct 26 2026

For the central North Pacific...between 140W and 180W:

Active Systems:
The National Hurricane Center is issuing advisories on Tropical
Storm Vance, located a few hundred miles south-southwest of
Manzanillo, Mexico, and on Tropical Depression Olana, located
several hundred miles west-southwest of Johnston Atoll.

Tropical cyclone formation is not expected during the next 7 days.

$$
Forecaster Katz/Cangialosi
NNNN

item.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Olana Public Advisory Number 7
item.description:
Issued at 500 PM HST Mon Oct 26 2026 
000
WTPA33 PHFO 270230
TCPCP3
 
BULLETIN
Post-Tropical Cyclone Olana Advisory Number   7
NWS Central Pacific Hurricane Center Honolulu HI   CP032026
Issued by NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
500 PM HST Mon Oct 26 2026
 
...OLANA NOW A REMNANT LOW...
...THIS IS THE LAST NHC ADVISORY...
 
 
SUMMARY OF 500 PM HST...0300 UTC...INFORMATION
----------------------------------------------
LOCATION...13.0N 175.9W
ABOUT 500 MI...800 KM WSW OF JOHNSTON ISLAND
MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS...30 MPH...45 KM/H
PRESENT MOVEMENT...SSE OR 150 DEGREES AT 7 MPH...11 KM/H
MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE...1007 MB...29.74 INCHES
 
 
WATCHES AND WARNINGS
--------------------
There are no coastal watches or warnings in effect.
 
 
DISCUSSION AND OUTLOOK
----------------------
At 500 PM HST (0300 UTC), the center of Post-Tropical Cyclone Olana 
was located near latitude 13.0 North, longitude 175.9 West. The 
post-tropical cyclone is moving toward the south-southeast near 7 
mph (11 km/h). A turn to the east is expected overnight.
 
Maximum sustained winds have decreased to near 30 mph (45 km/h) 
with higher gusts. Additional weakening is forecast, and Olana is 
expected to dissipate on Tuesday.

The estimated minimum central pressure is 1007 mb (29.74 inches).
 
 
HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND
----------------------
None.
 
 
NEXT ADVISORY
-------------
This is the last public advisory issued by the Central Pacific
Hurricane Center on this system.
 
$$
Forecaster Cangialosi

item.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Olana Forecast Discussion Number 7
item.description:
Issued at 500 PM HST Mon Oct 26 2026 
300 
WTPA43 PHFO 270231
TCDCP3
 
Post-Tropical Cyclone Olana Discussion Number   7
NWS Central Pacific Hurricane Center Honolulu HI   CP032026
Issued by NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
500 PM HST Mon Oct 26 2026

Olana has lacked organized deep convection for more than 12 hours,
and the circulation has become weak, elongated, and poorly defined.
Therefore, Olana is now considered a post-tropical cyclone. The
initial intensity is lowered to 25 kt, and even this could be
generous.
 
The remnant low has been moving south-southeastward at about 6 kt
over the past 12-18 hours. The low should turn eastward and weaken
some more overnight and then degenerate into an elongated trough on
Tuesday. Some of the models show the remnant trough merging with a
mid- to upper-level low pressure area that turns northwestward
toward the International Date Line by the end of the week.
 
This is the last NHC advisory on Olana.

FORECAST POSITIONS AND MAX WINDS
 
INIT  27/0300Z 13.0N 175.9W   25 KT  30 MPH...POST-TROP/REMNT LOW
 12H  27/1200Z 13.3N 175.1W   20 KT  25 MPH...POST-TROP/REMNT LOW
 24H  28/0000Z...DISSIPATED
 
$$
Forecaster Cangialosi
